changes.text: 俄国此前出兵占了新疆的伊犁；以西事自任、统兵经营新疆的左宗棠请与俄议还伊犁，朝廷诏遣全权大臣崇厚使俄，谈成一份条约。崇厚为朝士所纠，议了很久，议不出结果。作者的一种解释是：难处不在于要不要伊犁，而在于约已经签了；认账，是失地失利权在先；翻案，得有人去谈，还得有让对方重新坐下来的筹码。

Russia had earlier sent troops in and seized Ili, in Xinjiang. Zuo Zongtang, who had taken the western affairs upon himself and led the campaign in Xinjiang, asked that the return of Ili be negotiated with Russia, and the court sent Chong Hou, a plenipotentiary envoy, to Russia, where he concluded a treaty. Chong Hou was censured by court officials, and the debate dragged on toward no conclusion. One reading, the author's, is that the trouble was never whether Ili mattered, but that the treaty had already been signed. Accept it, and the lost territory and compromised rights stood as a fait accompli. Repudiate it, and someone had to go back to the table carrying enough leverage to make the other side sit down again.
先看这份奏疏落在什么样的局面里。传中所称的「帕夏」，是一位能役使回众的首领，他通使结援英、俄，购买兵械自备；英人暗中相助，想让他别立一国，用以屏障俄国。本文所据材料未录其名，也未写明他与伊犁之事的直接关系；这一句只交代英、俄各自插手的背景。俄方则因回众屡扰其边境，出兵逐回，占了伊犁，还说要代取乌鲁木齐。

Start with the situation the memorial landed in. The figure the biography calls the Pasha was a leader who could command the Muslim population; he sent envoys to seek support from Britain and Russia, and bought weapons to arm his own forces. The British backed him quietly, hoping to see him set up a separate state that would stand as a shield against Russia. The material used here does not give his name or spell out his direct connection to the Ili affair; this line serves only to show how Britain and Russia each had a hand in the region. Russia, for its part, because Muslim raiders repeatedly harassed its border, sent troops to drive them out, seized Ili, and announced that it would go on to take Urumqi on China's behalf.

dispositions.rationale: 在开头点明伊犁在新疆，并交代左宗棠以西事自任、统兵经营新疆，说明为什么由他请议还伊犁；没有补写官衔。中英文同步修改，ev 增补 E6、E17、E18。

evidence.quote: 自俄踞伊犁，蠶食不已，新疆乃有日蹙百里之勢

dispositions.rationale: 首次出现时说明「帕夏」是一位能役使回众的首领。没有采用建议中的“当地”和“原文未载其名”：前者证据不支持；后者无法确证，因为传全文可能记有其名。改为“本文所据材料未录其名，也未写明他与伊犁之事的直接关系”。中英文同步修改。

evidence.quote: 帕夏能屬役回眾，通使結援英、俄，購兵械自備
